source_binding_semantics: BindLayoutSource is reachable only from one live ShapeProvider. It verifies the compiled shape dependency identity and provider hash, inspects the provider's private graph/source/font lineage, rejects scalar limits, then receipt-exactly replays the complete LayoutGraph. That replay live-rebinds OutlineSet, exact GeometryFont, OutlineFont and complete static-glyf Font bytes. The replayed source/font pointers, provider receipt, graph hash, outline hash, font hash, metrics and counts must all equal the retained lineage before publication.
metric_semantics: units_per_em and signed hhea_ascender come from the revalidated static-glyf core and are bound into the layout-source hash. Glyph count must agree across Font, OutlineSet, LayoutGraph and ShapeProvider. Coordinates remain signed y-up font-space Q26.6 and no viewport scaling is performed.
outline_semantics: Every glyph is addressed only by uint32 glyph ID. A layout-bound glyph view exposes contour count and indexed Move/Line/Quad/Close command views; commands expose only scalar op, point count and copied Q26.6 points. Empty glyphs are valid. Glyph zero is viewable as font evidence but shaped-text assembly must reject it. No hint bytecode is executed.
hash_semantics: The layout-source hash is streaming SHA-256 over length-prefixed UTF-8 strings and fixed-width big-endian scalars. It binds the descriptor, provider dependency/build identity, complete graph/outline/font hashes, statuses, metrics, outline counts and portable resource charges. The hash field and canonical-byte count do not self-enter the preimage. JSON, maps, pointers, native integers, raw bytes and go-text objects never enter the preimage.
resource_semantics: All count limits and portable resources are admitted from scalar receipts and O(1) slice lengths before graph replay. work equals the retained provider work plus the layout-source canonical preimage bytes; working is max(provider working,64KiB); retained is provider retained plus 4KiB and receipt strings. The provider already retains the graph, outline and font lineage, so OutlineSet retained bytes are not charged twice. Counts and arithmetic are checked uint64 values and are logical portable charges, not allocator, GC or RSS guarantees.
ownership_semantics: LayoutSource retains its immutable ShapeProvider trust root and the exact OutlineSet already retained by it. New glyph and command views contain only a LayoutSource pointer plus scalar indices; they never return existing OutlineSet views, slices, backing arrays, raw font/table bytes, readers, Font objects or go-text types. Point returns a value copy. Successful sources support concurrent reads without mutable caches.
cancellation_semantics: A non-nil context is checked before work, throughout provider hashing and complete LayoutGraph replay, during final hashing and immediately before publication. Cancellation returns nil and a strictly zero receipt. The bridge itself performs no non-preemptible shaping call.
failure_semantics: Nil or drifted providers, dependency drift, graph/outline/font/metric/count mutation, receipt or hash mismatch, invalid limits, overflow, resource exhaustion, cancellation, allocation panic and invariant failure fail closed with nil LayoutSource and a zero receipt.
capability_semantics: This bridge exposes only receipt-bound font-space outline evidence for a later host-owned text raster provider. It does not rasterize, paint, composite, encode or advertise cutly.text.pinned-font-viewport-px.v2; final Text capability remains disabled.
excluded_responsibilities: Raw font access, system fonts, fallback, bidi inference, shaping, glyph selection, textlayout assembly, viewport scaling, hinting, curve flattening, coverage rasterization, paint, compositing, encoding, signing and persistence are outside this profile.
